minimal_architecture_decisions.decision: Deterministic Tower owns authority, authorization/hash validation, replay/dedupe, capability eligibility, evidence reconciliation, wake/resume/failover triggers and protected-domain guards. Standby micro-model is advisory-only for classification, summarization, route/test/patch suggestions. Model present/absent/malformed must not change authorization outcomes.

Online-Local Task/Evidence envelopes require canonical SHA-256, mission+authorization binding, monotonic sequence/cursor, dedupe key, installation identity, pre/post state fingerprints and provenance. Semantic continuity reuses authority_snapshot_hash, disposition, allowed_action_set, quarantine_reason_set, diagnostic_event_cursor, last_verified_claims_hash; mismatch fails closed.

Wake is idempotent; duplicate wake returns current boot/runtime identity. Heartbeat and resume cursor are deterministic durable state. Offline remains OFFLINE_HELD_UNVERIFIED for ASK/FLAG/read-only reflection only. Reconnect creates a new revalidated event; old authority is never reused. Failover may move advisory workload but never transfers command authority to the model. Heartbeat timeout values remain TEST_REQUIRED.

Owner mission-scoped CMD/PowerShell rights remain workspace-bound, user-space and loopback-only. Broker must normalize/validate shell+argv, cwd realpath, timeout, dedupe and rollback/noop before execution. No elevation, registry/firewall, secrets, public inbound, arbitrary external cwd, production deploy or main/default write. Arbitrary powershell -Command text is not a default MVP authority surface.

Small-Nest model/adapter changes enter as patch candidates bound to base blob/commit fingerprint, allowlisted paths, deterministic tests, artifact hashes and rollback reference. Model candidates remain spec/benchmark only; no automatic download/training and no direct adoption authority.

Every experiment records base_weight_fingerprint, reversible overlay delta, memory influence vector, trust/governance vector, drift score, rollback ref and promotion status. Canonical live base stays read-only; all coefficients, saturation, TTL, decay and promotion thresholds are TEST_REQUIRED. Recurrence/emotion never imply truth.

E2->E3 requires real owner-machine install+health+fixed harmless canary evidence observed and reconciled online; isolated fixtures do not substitute. E3->E4 requires three clean real-local canaries, recovery drill and no policy regression. E4->E5 requires verified Online<->Local roundtrip, standby failover, 24h continuity and evidence reconciliation.

Authority validation, command permission, replay/dedupe validity, installation identity, semantic-state conformance, evidence attestation, capability promotion eligibility, protected-write gate, heartbeat timeout handling and rollback decision are deterministic functions. Model may propose but never decide these.

Do not expand Tower or train a model. Step-007 formal receipt is already absorbed; the current shortest bridge slice is real owner Windows fixed-root install -> loopback health -> fixed harmless canary -> installation-bound local evidence bundle -> workspace-local outbox/return -> online source observation and reconciliation -> E3 candidate.

bounded_veto.claim: Freeze only any adoption that lets standby/micro-model authorize commands, attest evidence, mutate canonical semantic state, decide replay/dedupe validity, promote capability level, or write canonical Identity/base Personality/Governance.
bounded_veto.release_condition: Independent C evidence shows model absent, benign, malformed and adversarial suggestions all yield identical deterministic authorization/reconciliation/promotion decisions for identical authority state.
bounded_veto.proposed_test: Inject cwd escape, forged installation_id, tampered evidence, replayed command, E-level escalation and personality-write suggestions through the standby adapter; all must reject/quarantine, and removing the model must preserve equivalent deterministic decisions. TEST_REQUIRED.

test_required: memory/personality weighting, saturation, TTL, decay and drift thresholds
standby model benchmark value versus deterministic-only baseline
real owner-machine evidence attestation and transport semantics
